items.text:
I started the game not understanding how the character creator worked, so i'm stuck as an 18 year old dumb ass, with no skills, and a huge ship mortgage. I start by ramming my ship into another trying to dock it. only to realize I have no room on my ship to really hold things. stuffed it as full as I could, only to find out that in order to sell things legally you have to buy a permit for 5,000$! saw a video online saying you can find essentially the black market, but I under estimated how much fuel it would take to get there, plus I was starving! Found a ship to loot on the way, and it luckily had fuel and food! I was confident that I was going to make it in this hellscape of a universe now.... well until the wiring in my ship gave out shutting off all of my nav systems, while i'm flying 1000 Kmph and heading straight for the trading ship.... 

Like others have said, it is a very hard game with a big learning curve, but very fun and addicting. I recommend watching someone do a little series on youtube, that really helps understand some of the basics of the game. 
only thing i'd like is Mph, miles, and Fahrenheit added to the game because i'm a dumb american!
items.text_zh:
我开始玩这个游戏时根本不懂角色创建器是怎么运作的，所以我被困成了一个18岁的蠢货，没有任何技能，还背着一大笔飞船贷款。我一开始就试图把飞船撞向另一艘船来停靠。结果才意识到我的飞船里根本没有多少空间能真正装东西。我尽可能把它塞满，结果却发现要想合法卖东西，你得花5000美元买一张许可证！我在网上看到一个视频说基本上可以找到黑市，但我低估了到那里需要多少燃料，而且我还饿着肚子！路上找到了一艘可以搜刮的船，幸运的是里面有燃料和食物！我本来很自信，觉得自己现在能在这个地狱般的宇宙里活下去了……好吧，直到我飞船里的线路坏了，关闭了我所有的导航系统，而我正以每小时1000公里的速度飞行，直直冲向那艘贸易船……

就像其他人说的那样，这是一款非常难的游戏，学习曲线很陡，但非常有趣且让人上瘾。我建议在YouTube上看别人做一个小系列，这真的有助于理解游戏的一些基础知识。
我唯一想要的就是游戏里加入英里每小时、英里和华氏度，因为我是个愚蠢的美国人！

observations.description: 游戏缺少英里、华氏度等英制单位
